    // The inverse mass the solvers actually divide corrections by: zero for a
    // fixed vertex. Every projection below reads this instead of testing the
    // pin flag, so pinning is a mass of infinity and nothing more.
    SolverInverseMass(self: ClothVertex): Number
        => self.IsFixed ? 0.0 : self.InverseMass;
